name: openpms
description: OpenPMS - 智能体项目管理系统

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.desktop: npm run build:server && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop && npm run stage:desktop && npm run start -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:server && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop && npm run stage:desktop && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
